question: What state arises from relishing the devouring of time, and where is this taught?
premises: One who solely relishes devouring time becomes a sky-mover by himself.
This teaching is stated by the Supreme Lord in the tantra named Śrīḍāmara.
inference: Scriptural authority confirms that relishing the devouring of time leads spontaneously to the khecara state.
plain_english: One who solely relishes the devouring of time becomes a sky-mover by himself; this is said by the Supreme Lord in the tantra called Śrīḍāmara.
